hero.title: Crafting Luxury,
hero.description: From the finest Egyptian cotton to bespoke upholstery, Kemcon delivers unmatched quality to hotels and homes across the Middle East.

intro.heading: Crafting Premium Interiors Since 1985
intro.p1: For over four decades, Kemcon has been crafting luxury fabrics and furnishings for hotels, resorts, and residences across the Middle East. Every thread is selected for its texture, durability, and finish — from Egyptian cotton and linen to silk, velvet, and performance blends engineered for high-traffic hospitality environments.
intro.p2: Our Cairo manufacturing facility produces the full range of interior soft furnishings: bespoke curtains in sheer, blackout, and decorative fabrics; hand-upholstered chairs and sofas built to specification; and premium bed linen in hotel-grade Egyptian cotton and satin. Each piece is made to measure and quality-checked before delivery.
intro.p3: Kemcon works directly with architects, interior designers, procurement teams, and hospitality developers across Egypt, Saudi Arabia, the UAE, and Jordan. From a single custom piece to a full hotel fit-out, our team manages material selection, sampling, production, and logistics — delivering consistent luxury at any scale.

about.label: About Kemcon
about.title: A Legacy of Excellence
about.heroDescription: Originally established in 1985, Kemcon has evolved into one of the leading manufacturing groups in the region — trusted by elite hotel chains across the Middle East.
about.description: Kemcon has grown to become one of the leading manufacturing groups in the region. Through our diversified facilities, we have secured a strong market share across both corporate and business sectors. Egytex, the fabrics manufacturing arm of the Group, is the foundation of our craftsmanship.
about.descriptionSecondary: Our corporate business serves elite hotel chains with exclusive designs and high-quality fabrics, alongside a full spectrum of services: Cover, Tailoring, Installation, Mockup, Upholstery, and Furniture. Upon request, we provide samples and color swatches. We also offer special finishing and treatments complying with international standards — including Stain Protection, Fire Proof, and Anti-Fungus treatments.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.body: To be the definitive standard of luxury in fabrics and furnishings across the Middle East — setting the benchmark for quality that hotels and homes aspire to.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.body: To craft exceptional fabrics and furnishings that transform spaces into havens of comfort and elegance, while maintaining the artisanal quality that has defined us for over four decades.

suppliers.description: We source premium textiles from leading manufacturers across Europe, the Americas, Asia, and the Middle East.

leadership.bio1: With an engineer's precision and an artist's eye, Kamal Soliman founded Kemcon in 1985 and built it from the ground up into a leading manufacturing group serving elite hotel chains across the Middle East.
leadership.bio2: He personally oversaw the development of Egytex, the group's manufacturing arm, and led its regional expansion — driven by the belief that true quality is born in the details no one else notices.

sections.heading: Who we are
body: Kemcon is a fabric and furnishings manufacturer based in Cairo, Egypt. For the purposes of Egypt’s Personal Data Protection Law No. 151 of 2020 and the EU General Data Protection Regulation, we are the controller of the personal data described in this policy.

Kemcon operates from its factory at Street 151, Industrial Zone 1, Obour, Egypt, and a showroom on Ahmed Fakhry Street, Nasr City, Cairo. For any question about this policy, or to exercise any of the rights below, contact us at kemcon@yahoo.com.

sections.heading: What we collect
body: Information you give us. When you use the contact form or the product configurator we receive the name, phone number and email address you enter, the message you write, and any photographs you upload. If you build a product brief, it is saved in your own browser and reaches us only when you submit an enquiry.

Information collected automatically, only if you accept analytics. A randomly generated identifier stored in a cookie; the pages you view and how long you spend on them; the products, fabrics, colours and patterns you select; galleries you open and filters you apply; whether you began or submitted a form; and whether you clicked through to WhatsApp. We also record the two-letter country your request came from and the language you are reading the site in.

Information we process regardless. To keep the site working and to prevent abuse, we handle your IP address in passing, a signed counter limiting how many visualisations one browser may generate, and technical error reports when something breaks.
We do not ask for special category data — information about health, religion, politics or anything similar — and we ask that you do not send it to us.

sections.heading: When you send us something
body: There are two moments on this site where you actively hand us information. This is what happens at each.

The contact form. When you press send, the name, phone number, email address and message you entered are saved to our internal CRM — whose database is hosted in Frankfurt, Germany — and are emailed to our team so that we can reply. Any photographs you attach are uploaded to Cloudinary and kept with the enquiry. Our basis is the steps taken at your request before entering into a contract: you are asking us a question, and we need your details in order to answer it. We do not ask you to consent separately, because consent is not what makes this lawful.

The fabric visualiser. When you generate an image, we send a written description of the fabric, colour and piece you selected to an automated image service outside Egypt. That description is assembled from your choices in the configurator. No photograph of yours is sent with it, and nothing in it identifies you — the image that comes back is generated from that text alone.
In either case you can ask us afterwards to delete what you sent. See Your rights below.

sections.heading: Why we use it, and our legal basis
body: To answer your enquiry and prepare a quotation. Our basis is the steps taken at your request before entering into a contract, together with our legitimate interest in responding to business enquiries.
To generate a visualisation when you ask for one. Our basis is our legitimate interest in providing a feature you asked to use; only a written description of your selections leaves this site.
To understand how the site is used and to improve it. Our basis is your consent, given through the cookie banner, which you may withdraw at any time.
To keep the site secure, prevent abuse of the visualisation tool and diagnose faults. Our basis is our legitimate interest in running a functioning service that is not being abused.
To comply with legal obligations, where any apply to us.

sections.heading: Who we share it with
body: We do not sell personal data, and we do not share it for advertising.

We use service providers who process data on our instructions and under a written agreement: Vercel, which hosts this website and measures its performance; Neon, which hosts the database behind our internal CRM in Frankfurt, Germany; Cloudinary and UploadThing, which store and deliver images including photographs you upload; our automated image provider, which receives a written description assembled from your configurator selections in order to generate an image; our error monitoring provider; and our email provider, which delivers your enquiry to our team.
If you choose to continue the conversation on WhatsApp, that exchange is governed by WhatsApp’s own terms and privacy policy, not by this one.

sections.heading: Where your data goes
body: We are based in Egypt, the database behind our CRM is in the European Union, and some of our providers process data in the United States and elsewhere. Where personal data leaves your country we rely on the transfer mechanisms available under the applicable law — standard contractual clauses under the GDPR, and the conditions for cross-border transfer set out in Egypt’s Personal Data Protection Law.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
body: Website analytics are kept for 90 days. After that the events are deleted, and any visitor record left with no events and no associated enquiry is removed with them.

Enquiries, and the quotations that follow from them, are kept as part of our commercial records for as long as we have a relationship with you, and for as long afterwards as we need or are required to keep them.
Photographs you upload are kept with the enquiry they belong to and are deleted with it.
Your product brief stays in your own browser until you clear it.

sections.heading: Your rights
body: You may ask us for a copy of your personal data; to correct it; to delete it; to restrict or object to how we use it; to receive it in a portable form; and to withdraw any consent you have given. You can withdraw analytics consent at any time using the Cookie settings link in the footer. Withdrawing consent does not affect anything that was lawful before you withdrew it.
To exercise any of these, contact us at kemcon@yahoo.com. We will respond within the period the applicable law allows.

If you believe we have handled your data improperly, you may complain to Egypt’s Personal Data Protection Centre or, if you are in the European Economic Area, to the supervisory authority where you live or work.

sections.heading: Security
body: Traffic to this site is encrypted in transit. The visitor identifier is cryptographically signed so that it cannot be altered or guessed, our internal CRM requires a password before any data can be reached, and access is limited to the people who need it. No system is perfectly secure, but we treat these obligations seriously.

sections.heading: Children
body: This site is aimed at businesses and is not directed at children. We do not knowingly collect data from anyone under 18. If you believe a child has provided us with data, contact us and we will delete it.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
body: If we change how we use personal data we will update this page and the date shown at the top. Where a change affects something you consented to, we will ask you again rather than assume your previous answer still stands.

terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.intro: These terms govern your use of the Kemcon website. By using the site, you accept them. If you do not accept them, please do not use the site.

sections.heading: Who we are
body: This site is operated by Kemcon, a fabric and furnishings manufacturer in Egypt, with its factory at Street 151, Industrial Zone 1, Obour and a showroom on Ahmed Fakhry Street, Nasr City, Cairo. You can reach us at kemcon@yahoo.com.

sections.heading: What this site is
body: This website presents our products and capabilities and lets you send us an enquiry. It is not a shop. Nothing on it is an offer to sell, no price shown or quoted here is binding, and browsing creates no contract between us.

sections.heading: Enquiries and quotations
body: An enquiry, brief or configuration you submit is a request for us to get in touch. Any quotation we give in response is an indication until it is confirmed in a written agreement signed by both of us. Specifications, lead times and availability may change.

sections.heading: The visualisation tool
body: The configurator can generate an image suggesting how a fabric might look in a space, using an automated image service. What it produces is an illustration — not a specification, and not a sample.

Colour, texture, drape, scale and finish will differ from the real fabric, and screens vary in how they render colour. Please do not rely on a generated image when making a purchasing decision; ask us for a physical sample instead.
The tool is provided as it is. It may be unavailable, may limit how many images one visitor can generate, and may be withdrawn.

sections.heading: What you upload
body: You keep ownership of the photographs and text you send us.

You give us permission to use them only to handle your enquiry, including passing them to the service providers named in our Privacy Policy for that purpose. We will not use them in marketing, on this website, or in any portfolio without asking you first.

By uploading, you confirm that you are entitled to do so, that the material infringes nobody else’s rights, and that it contains nothing confidential, unlawful or offensive. Please do not upload photographs of identifiable people.

sections.heading: Acceptable use
body: Do not attempt to damage, overload, probe or gain unauthorised access to the site or the systems behind it. Do not scrape it systematically, misuse the forms to send unsolicited or fraudulent material, or use automated means to defeat the limits on the visualisation tool.

sections.heading: Our content
body: The text, images, fabric designs, photographs and layout of this site, and the Kemcon name and logo, belong to us or to our licensors. You may view and print pages for your own use in evaluating us as a supplier. Any other copying, republication or commercial use needs our written permission.

sections.heading: Links to other services
body: This site links to third-party services including WhatsApp, Google Maps and our social media pages. We do not control them and are not responsible for their content or for how they handle your data.

sections.heading: Availability
body: We aim to keep the site available but do not guarantee that it will be. We may change, suspend or withdraw any part of it, including the configurator, without notice.

sections.heading: Liability
body: Nothing in these terms excludes any liability that cannot lawfully be excluded, including liability for death or personal injury caused by negligence, or for fraud.

Beyond that, and so far as the law allows: this site is provided as it is, without warranties of any kind; we are not liable for indirect or consequential loss, or for loss of profit, business or data; and we are not liable for decisions taken in reliance on a generated visualisation rather than on a physical sample.

sections.heading: Privacy
body: Our Privacy Policy explains what we do with personal data collected through this site, and forms part of these terms.

sections.heading: Changes to these terms
body: We may update these terms from time to time. The version published on this page when you use the site is the version that applies.

sections.heading: Governing law
body: These terms are governed by the laws of the Arab Republic of Egypt, and the courts of Cairo have exclusive jurisdiction over any dispute arising from them.
